description: Corangamite Shire Solar Statistics is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Corangamite Shire Council. Usage statistics for Corangamite Shire Council solar panels. Coverage: Corangamite Shire Council. The portal files it under the publisher Corangamite Shire Council . Its tags are power, solar, solar power. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-07-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
